title: Scholarship Programme 2
summary: KAAD scholarship programme for students from developing or emerging countries pursuing Master's, Diplom, Magister, or PhD degrees at German higher education institutions, with specific denominational and language requirements.

degree_levels.notes: Covers Master's degree, Diplom, Magister degree, or a PhD at a German higher education institution.

subject_areas.notes: Specific subject areas are not mentioned on the page.

institutions.notes: Applies to German higher education institutions generally.

nationality.notes: Must come from a developing or emerging country in Africa, Asia, the Middle East or Latin America.

residence.notes: Applicants must be already studying in Germany and have at least 10 months of study remaining.

mandatory.text: Come from a developing or emerging country in Africa, Asia, the Middle East or Latin America.
Already studying in Germany with at least 10 months of study remaining.
Pursuing a Master's degree, Diplom, Magister degree, or a PhD at a German higher education institution.
Catholic denomination, or Christian denomination (especially for Near and Middle East), or another religion if proposed by Catholic partners for interreligious dialogue.
Knowledge of German language at least at a communication level.

preferences.text: Above-average performance potential for studies or research.
Orientation of studies or research towards a permanent reintegration into the respective home region.
Religious and social commitment or willingness to engage in inter-religious dialogue.

funding.description: Details regarding exact base stipend amounts, currency, and frequencies are not specified on the page.

application_rounds.notes: The selection committee meets twice a year. Exact application deadlines must be obtained from the local KHG/KSG.

steps.text: Applications can be made exclusively through the Catholic University Chaplaincies (KHG or KSG) at your university location.
Contact the responsible KHG/KSG at your university.
